nodes.name: CC - Advisor - Dissatisfied With Advisor
nodes.description: Roll up for all of the Dissatisfied with Advisor topics. This includes Not Efficient, Not Helpful, Not Knowledgeable, Pushy Sales, Rude, Unspecified Dissatisfaction, Confusing/Makes No Sense, Inaccurate Information, Misled/Lied to/Deceptive, Call Clarity – Hard to Hear, Call Clarity – Say That Again, and Call Clarity – Language Barrier. This node does not have any rules.

nodes.name: CC Advisor - Confusing/Makes No Sense
nodes.description: Customer mentions of being confused or feeling like something does not make sense EXCLUDE mentions of the dealer and Roadside
nodes.ai_description: Assign 'CC Advisor - Confusing/Makes No Sense' ONLY when the customer EXPLICITLY complains that the ADVISOR, or the information/instructions the advisor gave, was confusing, unclear, made no sense, or contradictory (e.g. 'you are confusing me', 'what you told me makes no sense', 'that explanation is not clear'). The confusion MUST be blamed on the advisor or the information given - NOT the customer's own state. Do NOT assign for: the customer merely asking a question or for clarification; thinking aloud, hesitation, or 'I don't know' / 'I'm not sure'; the customer's own general confusion or uncertainty not attributed to the advisor; confusion about a product, app, website, bill, or process rather than the advisor's words; the advisor apologizing for confusion; or positive/neutral phrasing ('I understand', 'that makes sense', 'if that makes sense'). Exclude confusion about a DEALER/dealership or ROADSIDE (out of scope). Most sentences do NOT qualify - when in doubt, do not assign.

nodes.name: CC Advisor - Inaccurate Information
nodes.description: Customer mentions of being given inaccurate information or directions or the advisor putting in wrong information EXCLUDE mentions of the dealer and Roadside
nodes.ai_description: Assign 'CC Advisor - Inaccurate Information' ONLY when the customer says the ADVISOR gave them information or directions that were incorrect, false, inaccurate, not true, or wrong, or entered wrong information (e.g. 'the advisor told me the wrong information', 'what you told me was not true'). Do NOT assign when: the CUSTOMER gave or entered the wrong information; the problem is an app, website, sensor, GPS, display, or system, or a reading like tire pressure, fuel gauge, mileage, or charge status; 'wrong' means a wrong number, button, name, person, vehicle, or paperwork, or a data field (account, billing, payment, card, or vehicle information); the complaint is about a dealer, salesperson, finance, or technician (out of scope, with Roadside); or 'not right'/'wrong' is about timing ('right now', 'right away') or a generic 'something is wrong'. Do NOT assign for dissatisfaction with the outcome ('that is not what I asked for') unless the customer says the information itself was wrong.

nodes.name: Loyalty - Card
nodes.description:
DEFINITION: Mentions related to GM credit cards

INCLUDE: GM, GMC, Buick, Chevy, Cadillac, marcus, and BuyPower cards; rewards tiers (silver, gold, platinum)
nodes.ai_description: Assign 'Loyalty - Card' when the customer refers to a GM-branded credit card - the GM Card, GMC/Buick/Chevy/Cadillac Card, BuyPower Card, or the Marcus/Goldman Sachs account that backs it (applying for it, its rewards/earnings, balance, payments, or the card account). nodes.name: Loyalty Rewards - Points
nodes.description:
DEFINITION: Mentions related to GM My Rewards points
INCLUDES: explicit reference of points
nodes.ai_description: Assign 'Loyalty Rewards - Points' when the customer explicitly refers to or INQUIRES about GM My Rewards points - their points balance, earning points, reward or bonus points, point vouchers, or how points work. An inquiry or question counts, not only a complaint, as long as rewards points are explicitly mentioned. Do NOT assign it when 'point(s)' is used in a non-rewards sense (e.g. 'point of view', 'point out', 'point of contact', 'that is a good point', compass directions or place names).
